## Onboarding Playbooks
### Receptionist 3-Minute Quick Start: D4W & EXACT Trojan Horse (Receptionist — 3 min)
1. Open DentAI in Chrome or Edge tab alongside your PMS window.
2. Upload morning appointment roster via screenshot snip (Ctrl+V) or PDF.
3. At patient check-out, paste the clinician note directly into D4W progress notes.
4. Look for the [FRONT DESK ACTION ITEM] block: read the itemized quote and take the booking deposit.

### Dentist 90-Second Chairside Flow: Zero-Typing Scribe (Dentist — 2 min)
1. Glance at the amber "Pre-Op Brief" cue before inviting the patient into the operatory.
2. Click "Start Scribe" and speak naturally to the patient during exam/procedure.
3. Click "Complete & Review Note" at end of appointment.
4. Click "Copy Note" and paste into your PMS chart; click "Copy SMS" to text patient aftercare.
